candidates.candidate: General alien-power precedence recital
candidates.rationale: The rulebook says alien powers take precedence over conflicting game rules. Correctly applying that original-base power beyond the ordinary cap exercises the same priority outcome. An abstract recital would not add a materially different rule, branch or priority result. Q019 remains distinct simultaneous-effect ordering, but that distinction alone does not establish novelty.
